The e-commerce platform described in the text faces significant security vulnerabilities related to cloud data storage and access controls. Specifically, the failure to configure proper network access controls has resulted in unrestricted access to storage buckets. This misconfiguration allows unauthorized entities to access the data, leading to data leaks. This is a classic example of insecure direct object references or misconfigured cloud storage permissions, which are critical issues in cloud security.

Regarding the additional question embedded in the text: The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is a zebra.
